uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

101-4113-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by tapping Vampire Charmseeker due to Splash Portal's convoke ability, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2577-6664-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6664-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1228-5470-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
1228-5470-8095.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat from step 2.

5226-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

3519-7730-7908.easyPrerequisites: The Notary Hobbits' commander tax is 8 or less.
3519-7730-7908.description:
Cast The Notary Hobbits by paying {3}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When The Notary Hobbits enters, it triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of it.
Activate The Notary Hobbits and the two Notary Hobbits tokens by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Halfling you control.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the nontoken Notary Hobbits, adding six {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return The Notary Hobbits from exile to the command zone.
Repeat.
3519-7730-7908.notes: It's possible to start with a higher commander tax, but you'll need to control more Halflings and/or have more mana to start.

1495-6919-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1495-6919-7803.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-6919-7803.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-5570-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2806-2862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl
1618-2440-2806-2862.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2806-2862.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-4742-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

628-2921-7214.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

1409-1418-2307.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve both Corsair Captain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

5259-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5259-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

147-2292-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2292-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

3698-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 5.

1563-4231-4321-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating a Foods, a Clue, a Treasure and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate two of the artifact tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.
1563-4231-4321-5777.notes: You can sacrifice the Foods to their own abilities instead - you will simply tap the Clue and Treasure for mana instead.

2866-2981-4986-5034.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

687-2281-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Saffi Eriksdotter is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Saffi Eriksdotter is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-2281-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Saffi Eriksdotter by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Saffi Eriksdotter enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Saffi Eriksdotter.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Saffi Eriksdotter and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-2281-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

38-301-2646.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-2646.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat.

413-1365-3263-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-1365-3263-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1429-1477-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-1477-5958.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

1741-3230-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1741-3230-5900.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Coral Atoll and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

1754-4766-5256-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
1754-4766-5256-5683.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Guan Yu's power.
Repeat.

722-2665-3153.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-2665-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2292-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2292-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

859-4395.notablePrerequisites:
Lightning Prowess attached to Lurking Roper.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
859-4395.description:
Give Lurking Roper lifelink, if needed.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1675-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
1675-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Ob Nixilis' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ob Nixilis.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
